why: The reader quotes the heading "מתי הכי משתלם למשוך?" only to say which part of the page they used. They never say the calculator fails to show the best time to withdraw. Their related complaints are about something else: they wanted numbers on the bars for years 6 to 12 and a total for their own salary. Their 6-year plan came from the "מה זה" text, not from the calculator.
